zh.summary: 用現況調查找到值得追問的工作問題，再用中立訪談確認情境，分清回答、解釋與尚待驗證的需求。
objectives: 將工具經驗調查與工作需求問題分開。
改寫誘導式問題，詢問具體工作事件。
從合成回答建立訪談追問、假設與需求紀錄，不宣稱已取得真實使用者證據。

readingGuide.goal: 用現況調查找到值得追問的問題，保留回答、推論與驗證的區別。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 先閱讀一段明確標為虛構的缺件經驗，不需要採訪真實業務。
readingGuide.route: 先設計有用途的問題，再練習中立追問，最後將合成回答轉成待驗證需求。
readingGuide.output: problem.md 的需求線索附錄：調查問題、訪談追問、假設與驗證動作。

sections.heading: 先問工作，再決定要展示哪個工具
paragraphs: 工作坊開始時，你可以詢問大家是否用過 Coding Agent、能否啟動 Python，以及希望改善哪一項工作。工具經驗能幫教師安排支援方式；工作困難則提供需求線索。兩類回答用途不同，不應把「用過某工具」當成已具備完整工程能力。
對自學者來說，也可以先回答同樣問題，再檢查自己的假設。請把「我想做一個 AI 系統」接著寫成「誰在什麼工作時機遇到困難」，讓後續學習有可討論的對象。

sections.heading: 像到餐廳前先知道用餐需求
paragraphs: 安排用餐時，只問大家喜歡哪一家店，未必知道是否有人需要無障礙入口、是否趕時間或有其他必要條件。先知道使用情境，才有辦法判斷推薦是否合適。
同樣地，詢問大家偏好哪一種程式框架，不能直接解釋收件工作為什麼卡住。你需要知道他們在哪一步、碰到哪一種資料、如何補救，以及結果由誰接手。這些問題會影響需求與介面。

sections.heading: 讓每個調查問題都有明確用途
paragraphs: 課前或現場調查可以幫你整理工具經驗、工作角色與困難線索。每題都應知道答案將如何影響授課或下一步研究；不需要的姓名、正式案件編號、個人聯絡資訊就不收集。若只做課堂示範，使用合成回答即可。
選項也要留出「未使用」「不確定」「目前不方便回答」等適當回應，避免迫使人選擇不符合經驗的答案。若開放自由文字，提醒只描述一般流程，不填入非公開業務或個人資料。這是本課的調查設計取捨，不代表已建立線上調查服務。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜可以用於課堂討論的調查題
rows: 最近一次啟動本機程式時，你在哪一步需要協助？
具體環境與操作困難
安排環境示範或同儕支援，不把困難歸因為能力不足
請描述交接一份資料前，你通常做的檢查
現行工作與規則線索
訪談檢查項目的負責人及例外情境
最近一次需要補件時，從發現到完成發生了什麼？
事件順序與影響
畫出現行工作流程，找出需要進一步確認的步驟
如果這次只能改善一個步驟，你會選哪裡？理由是什麼？
受訪者的優先順序
比較不同角色，不直接當作第一版範圍的最終決策

sections.heading: 把誘導式問題改成中立的事件追問
paragraphs: 「如果有 AI 自動檢查，你是不是就能大幅提升效率？」同時暗示了解法與期待效果。即使對方回答同意，你仍不知道原本工作如何進行，也沒有測量效率改善。
可以改問：「請描述最近一次發現缺件的經過。你當時先做什麼？怎麼知道少了什麼？後來如何處理？」再依回答追問，確認你理解的是同一個事件。GOV.UK 的深度訪談指南強調開放、中立問題與具體故事，也建議先試問同事以修正不清楚的提問。
對方說「系統很慢」時，可以追問是等待畫面、重複輸入，還是找不到下一步。先保留原來的說法，再記錄你對可能原因的解釋；不要未經確認就把問題改成「需要更快的模型」。

sections.heading: 從一個合成回答走向待驗證需求
paragraphs: 以下是虛構示範回答，不是實際學員或機關訪談：「我常到交接時才發現文件類型沒填，然後要再問一次送件者。」它提供了欄位、發現時機與補救動作的線索，但還沒有告訴我們發生頻率、誰定義必要欄位，或改成系統提示後是否有效。
你可以追問：「最近一次是怎麼發現的？填寫與複核由同一人做嗎？哪一份規則說明文件類型必填？」接著暫寫假設：「在交接前顯示必要欄位缺漏，可能減少漏看。」再用合成案例與原型任務試用來檢查提示是否可理解。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜把回答轉成可以驗證的需求線索
blocks.description: 每一步保留自己的證據狀態。示範回答與示範結果都不能寫成真實調查發現。

items.title: 記錄回答
items.body: 保留對方實際描述的事件；本課範例則明寫為合成回答。

items.title: 中立追問
items.body: 確認角色、時機、規則來源與補救過程，不預設工具解法。

items.title: 提出假設
items.body: 把對原因及可能改善的解釋列為待驗，不冒充直接觀察。

items.title: 安排驗證
items.body: 在規格中寫可觀察情境，再透過任務試用檢查效果。

sections.heading: 調查結果需要保留來源與範圍
paragraphs: 「這次回覆者中有人提到補件」與「所有同仁主要都被補件拖慢」是不同強度的結論。自願回覆、樣本來源、未回覆者與不同工作角色，都會影響你能從結果說到哪裡。先記錄這輪收到了什麼，再決定還需要詢問誰。
匿名化也要看整體內容。沒有姓名的自由文字仍可能包含足以辨識某人的細節；公開教學時可改用一般角色、合成資料與去識別化摘錄。需要記錄真人訪談時，先說明用途與記錄方式，取得適當同意，再依實際規範保管；本課練習不要求收集真人資料。
把調查線索接到 M03 的 problem.md：標出回答來源、你提出的假設、待確認問題與下一個驗證動作。等工作流程與需求較清楚，再決定第一版的範圍。不要將問卷票數直接當成所有需求的優先順序。

exercise.environment: 文字編輯器與本課提供的合成回答；不需建立問卷網站或收集真人資料。
steps: 在 problem.md 的需求線索小節寫三個問題，分別了解工具操作、工作事件及目前優先困難，逐題註明用途。
將一題含「你是不是也覺得」的誘導問法，改成開放、中立、可追問最近事件的問題。
使用本課合成回答，分欄記錄回答內容、你的解釋、待確認假設與下一步驗證。
請同儕試讀提問，指出是否預設答案、是否可能要求個資，再修正問題。
exercise.expected: 一份有用途說明的調查題目，以及合成回答到訪談追問、假設與驗證的對照。
exercise.check: 同儕能分清哪些是合成回答、哪些是你的推論，以及哪一項需要後續觀察；沒有把示範結果稱為真實訪談發現。
exercise.cleanup: 只保留合成回答與去識別化回饋；若誤填真實姓名、業務細節或聯絡資料，移除後再分享。

en.summary: Use a current-state survey to find work problems worth investigating, then ask neutral interview questions to distinguish reported answers, interpretations and unverified requirements.
objectives: Separate questions about tool experience from questions about work needs.
Rewrite leading questions to ask about concrete work events.
Use synthetic answers to develop follow-up questions, assumptions and requirements records without claiming actual user evidence.

readingGuide.goal: Use a current-state survey to identify questions worth pursuing while separating answers, interpretations and verification.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Read a missing-document experience clearly labeled as fictional; no actual business interview is needed.
readingGuide.route: Design purposeful questions, practice neutral follow-ups, then turn synthetic answers into unverified requirements.
readingGuide.output: A requirements-leads appendix in problem.md containing survey questions, interview follow-ups, assumptions and verification actions.

sections.heading: Ask About Work Before Choosing a Tool Demonstration
paragraphs: At the start of a workshop, ask whether learners have used a Coding Agent, whether they can start Python, and which work task they want to improve. Tool experience helps instructors arrange support; work difficulties provide requirements leads. These answers serve different purposes. Using a tool does not establish complete engineering ability.

Self-study learners can answer the same questions and inspect their assumptions. Follow “I want to build an AI system” with “Who faces a difficulty, and at which point in their work?” Give the later learning a concrete situation to discuss.

sections.heading: Like Understanding Dining Needs Before Choosing a Restaurant
paragraphs: Asking only which restaurant people prefer may miss needs such as an accessible entrance, limited time or other required conditions. Understand the situation before deciding whether a recommendation fits.

Likewise, a preferred programming framework does not explain why intake work gets stuck. Ask at which step the difficulty occurs, which data is involved, how people recover and who takes over the result. These questions shape requirements and interfaces.

sections.heading: Give Every Survey Question a Purpose
paragraphs: A pre-class or live survey can reveal tool experience, work roles and leads about difficulties. Know how each answer will affect teaching or further research. Do not collect names, official case IDs or contact details that are unnecessary for that purpose. Synthetic answers are sufficient for a classroom demonstration.

Offer suitable responses such as “not used,” “not sure” and “prefer not to answer now,” so people are not forced into an inaccurate option. For free text, request general workflow descriptions without nonpublic business or personal data. These are course survey-design choices; no online survey service has been built.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Survey Questions for Classroom Discussion
rows: When you last started a local program, at which step did you need help?
Specific environment and interaction difficulties.
Arrange a setup demonstration or peer support without attributing difficulty to lack of ability.
Describe the checks you normally perform before handing over a record.
Current work and possible rules.
Interview the owners of checking rules and investigate exceptions.
During the most recent request for missing documents, what happened from discovery to completion?
Event sequence and impact.
Map the current flow and identify steps needing confirmation.
If you could improve only one step this time, which would you choose and why?
The respondent’s priorities.
Compare roles without treating the answer as the final first-release scope decision.

sections.heading: Replace Leading Questions with Neutral Event Follow-Ups
paragraphs: “If AI checked automatically, wouldn’t your efficiency improve greatly?” suggests both a solution and an expected effect. Agreement still tells you little about the original workflow and does not measure improved efficiency.

Ask instead: “Describe the most recent time you discovered missing documents. What did you do first? How did you identify what was missing? What happened next?” Follow the answer to confirm you are discussing the same event. GOV.UK’s in-depth interview guidance emphasizes open, neutral questions and concrete stories, and recommends trying questions with a colleague to improve unclear wording.

If someone says “the system is slow,” ask whether they mean waiting for a screen, re-entering information or not knowing the next step. Retain their wording before recording your possible explanation. Do not turn it into “we need a faster model” without confirmation.

sections.heading: Turn a Synthetic Answer into an Unverified Requirement
paragraphs: This is a fictional demonstration answer, not an actual learner or organizational interview: “I often discover the document type is blank only at handoff, and then I have to ask the sender again.” It suggests a field, a discovery point and a recovery action. It does not establish frequency, who defines required fields or whether a system prompt would help.

Follow up: “How was the most recent omission discovered? Does the same person enter and review the data? Which rule makes document type required?” Then record a provisional assumption: “Showing missing required fields before handoff may reduce overlooked omissions.” Use synthetic cases and a prototype task trial to check whether the prompt is understandable.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Turn an Answer into a Verifiable Requirements Lead
blocks.description: Retain the evidence status of each step. Demonstration answers and results must not be reported as actual survey findings.

items.title: Record the answer
items.body: Retain the event the person described; label course examples as synthetic.

items.title: Ask neutral follow-ups
items.body: Confirm roles, timing, rule sources and recovery without assuming a tool-based solution.

items.title: Propose a hypothesis
items.body: Keep explanations of causes and possible improvements unverified, distinct from direct observation.

items.title: Arrange verification
items.body: Write observable scenarios in the specification, then inspect outcomes through a task trial.

sections.heading: Retain the Source and Scope of Survey Findings
paragraphs: “Some respondents in this round mentioned missing-document requests” supports a narrower conclusion than “missing documents are the main delay for all colleagues.” Voluntary responses, recruitment sources, nonrespondents and work roles affect what you can conclude. Record what this round received, then decide whom to ask next.

Anonymization also depends on the whole account. Free text without a name can still contain identifying details. Use general roles, synthetic data and de-identified excerpts in public teaching. If recording actual interviews, explain their purpose and recording method, obtain appropriate consent and follow applicable handling rules. This exercise does not require collecting actual participant data.

Connect survey leads to M03’s problem.md: identify answer sources, hypotheses, unanswered questions and the next verification action. Choose first-release scope after understanding work and requirements more clearly. Survey vote counts alone do not determine every requirement’s priority.

exercise.environment: A text editor and the supplied synthetic answer. No survey website or actual participant data is needed.
steps: In the requirements-leads section of problem.md, write three questions about tool operation, a work event and the current highest-priority difficulty, explaining each question’s purpose.
Rewrite one leading question containing “don’t you also think” as an open, neutral question about a recent event.
Using the synthetic answer, separately record the answer, your interpretation, an unconfirmed hypothesis and the next verification action.
Have a peer read the questions for assumed answers or possible requests for personal data, then revise them.
exercise.expected: Purposeful survey questions and a mapping from a synthetic answer to interview follow-ups, hypotheses and verification.
exercise.check: A peer can distinguish the synthetic answer from your interpretations and identify what needs later observation. Demonstration results are not labeled as actual interview findings.
exercise.cleanup: Retain only synthetic answers and de-identified feedback. Remove any accidentally entered names, business details or contact information before sharing.

zh.prompt: 以下哪個問題較適合了解收件工作困難？
options: 請描述最近一次發現缺件時，從發現到處理完的經過
你喜歡最先進的模型嗎？
為什麼你們都不用自動化？
你是不是也覺得 AI 會讓工作更有效率？
rationales: 它提供具體事件與後續追問的入口，不預設解法。
工具偏好無法直接說明工作困難。
它先下了未經確認的判斷，也可能使受訪者防衛。
它暗示期待的答案，沒有詢問實際流程。

en.prompt: Which question best explores difficulties in intake work?
options: Describe the most recent missing-document event from discovery through resolution.
Do you like the most advanced model?
Why does nobody here use automation?
Don’t you also think AI will make work more efficient?
rationales: It opens a concrete event to follow-up without assuming a solution.
Tool preference does not directly explain work difficulty.
It starts with an unconfirmed judgment and may put the respondent on the defensive.
It suggests the desired answer rather than asking about actual work.

zh.prompt: 三位自願回覆者提到補件，最精確的紀錄是？
options: 問卷無法使用，所以刪除回答
所有同仁都以補件為最大困難
已證明自動化可節省一半時間
這輪三位回覆者提到補件；仍需確認情境、其他角色及影響
rationales: 有限的回答仍可提供線索，重點是適當解釋。
這把有限回答推成全體結論。
尚未測量改善效果，不能編造數字。
這保留觀察範圍，也列出下一步。

en.prompt: Three voluntary respondents mention missing-document requests. Which record is most precise?
options: Delete the answers because the survey is unusable.
Every colleague considers missing documents the biggest difficulty.
Automation has been proven to save half the time.
Three respondents in this round mentioned missing documents; context, other roles and impact still need confirmation.
rationales: Limited answers can still provide leads if interpreted appropriately.
That generalizes limited responses to everyone.
No improvement has been measured, so the number is unsupported.
This retains the observed scope and identifies the next step.

zh.prompt: 哪個做法符合本課的現況調查目的？
options: 把合成回答標成真實學員意見
用過 Agent 就視為已通過課程
只詢問會影響授課或需求研究的資訊，並將線索接到後續訪談
為避免漏資料，收集姓名、正式案件編號及密碼
rationales: 示範材料必須清楚保留合成來源。
工具經驗不等於已具備需求、設計與驗證能力。
每題有用途，回答有後續確認方式，才能形成可用需求線索。
這些資訊不符合本課用途，也不需要用於教學練習。

en.prompt: Which practice fits this course’s current-state survey purpose?
options: Label synthetic answers as actual learner opinions.
Treat previous agent use as passing the course.
Ask only for information that affects teaching or requirements research, then follow leads with interviews.
Collect names, official case IDs and passwords to avoid missing information.
rationales: Demonstration materials must retain their synthetic provenance.
Tool experience does not establish requirements, design and verification skills.
Purposeful questions and a way to confirm answers produce useful requirements leads.
Those details are unnecessary for this course’s teaching purpose.
